name: minimal-card
title: Minimal Card
blurb: Composable minimal card with image, title, description, footer sections.
description: A rounded card container with sub-components (MinimalCardImage, MinimalCardTitle, MinimalCardDescription, etc.). Supports light/dark mode with layered shadow effects.
use_when: Product showcases, blog cards, or feature listings where minimalist design and semantic structure enable flexibility.
avoid_when: High-content cards where complex layering might reduce readability or create visual noise.
a11y: Card is semantic container; sub-components use standard HTML elements (h3, p). Images require alt text.
